| Step | tidymodels | scikit-learn |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Hold out a test set | `initial_split()`, `training()`, `testing()` | `train_test_split()` |
| 2. Prepare the inputs | `recipe()` plus `step_*()` | `ColumnTransformer` plus transformers |
| 3. Name the model | `linear_reg()`, `rand_forest()` | `LinearRegression()`, `RandomForestRegressor()` |
| 4. Join the two | `workflow()` | `Pipeline` |
| 5. Fit | `fit()` | `.fit()` |
| 6. Predict | `augment()`, `predict()` | `.predict()` |
| 7. Score | `rmse()` | `root_mean_squared_error()` |
